newsitem.title: USA: Palatin to implement FDA suggestions.
newsitem.headline: Palatin to implement FDA suggestions.

text.p: Palatin Technologies Inc said Thursday announced that it believes that suggestions by the U.S. Food and Drug on clincial trials of its kit-packaged radiolabeled antibody for infection imaging can be implemented without substantial impact on its development timelines.
The company said it met with the FDA on August 7 on its upcoming Investigational New Drug (IND) application for LeuTech.
At the meeting, the company presented the recent results of an initial clinical study by researchers at UCLA/Harbor Medical Center in Los Angeles.

According to Palatin, during the study, the clinical investigators found that LeuTech demonstrated rapid infection site imaging and high overall diagnostic accuracy without the need for laboratory white blood cell separation and radiolabeling.
